bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true
echo STK_DM_BOT_RUNNING=PASS
echo STK_SHOP_PORT_BINDINGS="$(docker inspect -f '{{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}}' "$n" | grep -o '18766' | wc -l)"
echo STK_SHOP_18766_CONTAINER_COUNT="$(docker ps --format '{{.Ports}}' | grep -c '18766' || true)"
printf 'STK_SHOP_18766_HTTP_STATUS='
curl --silent --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 4 --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:18766/health || true
printf '\nSTK_SHOP_18766_SERVICE_LABEL='
curl --silent --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 4 http://127.0.0.1:18766/health | grep -o 'CreateVdobot sticker shop' || echo UNKNOWN
echo STK_DM_PORT_PREFLIGHT=PASS
